title: Replication Codebase: Decarbonizing Turkish Black Sea Commercial Fisheries Requires Pairing Industrial Engine-Power Limits with Capacity Reduction
description: Reproducible Python analytical pipeline, naval-architectural resistance models, non-parametric directional distance frontier solvers, spatial autocorrelation diagnostics, panel econometric specifications, and 600-DPI publication figure scripts for the study: Decarbonizing Turkish Black Sea Commercial Fisheries Requires Pairing Industrial Engine-Power Limits with Capacity Reduction, published in the Turkish Journal of Maritime and Marine Sciences (DOI: 10.52998/trjmms.2042258). In accordance with institutional data-governance protocols, raw and processed datasets are not redistributed in this archive; full institutional data-source documentation and retrieval instructions (GFCM, FAO FishStatJ, TÜİK, BSGM, TCMB, CMEMS, NOAA OISST, and Global Fishing Watch) are provided in data/README.md.
journal_title: Turkish Journal of Maritime and Marine Sciences
